strategicQuestions.q: 1. Does SkillMarket support keeping Diagnostic Pack?
strategicQuestions.evidence: 14 real defects found. 5 critical+high confirmed actionable. Repair verified accuracy. Diagnostic Pack earned its place.
Single-agent readonly diagnostic found 14 defects faster than multi-agent would. Multi-agent adds overhead without better detection for this project class. AGENT-9-P3 strategy stands.
SkillMarket is a student project, not a benchmark. No comparative data (Vanilla vs Multi-agent on same project). One diagnostic trial is not enough to unblock v0.5. AGENT-9-P3 gates still apply.

Multi-agent CONDITIONAL, not default — confirmed. 7-agent CUT — confirmed. 10-role CUT — confirmed. 4-agent P1 KEEP CONDITIONALLY — confirmed. v0.5 BLOCKED — confirmed. Vanilla product leader — confirmed. Diagnostic Pack primary option — VALIDATED.

strategicQuestions.q: 5. Should next phase be Diagnostic Pack P1, second benchmark, or stop/user review?
strategicQuestions.evidence: SkillMarket trial showed Diagnostic Pack works but needs quick-mode and student-project refinements. P1 is low-risk documentation improvement. Second benchmark requires user commitment and project selection. Stop/user review is always an option.

strategicConclusion.diagnosticPack: SUPPORTED — keep and improve with P1 quick-mode enhancements
strategicConclusion.recommendedNextPhase: FACTORY-DIAGNOSTIC-PACK-P1 (Quick Mode + Student Project Mode) — documentation-only improvements, low risk
strategicConclusion.alternativeNextPhase: FACTORY-AGENT-10 (Second Benchmark) — only if user wants to resolve multi-agent question definitively
